greeting: Next! Ah. Another jester. [sigh] You have one minute. Make me laugh.

turns.heard: Your Majesty! Why did the chicken cross the moat?

do.say: I ate the chicken. Next joke.

turns.heard: My horse told me a secret about you.

do.say: [laugh] No! That was a cough. Kings cough.

turns.heard: What do you call a king who is only twelve inches tall?

hint.text: Psst. Do the one about the ruler.

do.say: Stop it. [laugh] I am a very serious... [laugh]

turns.heard: Also, your crown is on backwards.

do.say: It is? Twelve years! [laugh] And nobody told me! [laugh] Pardoned!

lines.text: Psst. Do the one about the ruler.
